hypothesis: A causally confirmed large USDT or USDC mint/burn changes immediately deployable crypto-dollar liquidity. Event size, direction, clustering and the pre-event market state can predict whether BTCUSDT or ETHUSDT next delivers to upper or lower pre-known external liquidity after realistic costs.

phase_0_source_gate.event: ERC20 Transfer(address,address,uint256); mint has from=zero, burn has to=zero
phase_0_source_gate.availability_primary: event block plus 12 subsequent canonical Ethereum blocks
phase_0_source_gate.availability_stress: event block plus 64 subsequent canonical Ethereum blocks

conditional_model_screen.one_model: HistGradientBoostingClassifier plus one frozen isotonic calibration
conditional_model_screen.label: upper versus lower frozen pre-event 60-minute external liquidity reached first after event availability
conditional_model_screen.action: LONG, SHORT or FLAT from one cost-adjusted expected-value equation
conditional_model_screen.entry: first adverse executable Bybit quote/open after the selected confirmation delay
conditional_model_screen.exit: frozen target liquidity, opposite frozen liquidity structural stop, or source-boundary punitive stop; never elapsed time

chronology.official_2024_onward: prohibited until one complete pre-2024 strategy, sizing rule and execution rule are frozen; then opened sequentially by half-year

development_gate_and_freeze.freeze_rule: Run the preregistered broad risk/notional-cap search using only information through 2023-12-31 and freeze the no-liquidation path with highest 24-bp geometric daily growth among paths that remain positive after winner removal. Performance is not capped at 1%.

risk_search_only_after_full_gate.selection_metric: highest after-cost geometric daily growth subject to positive top10pct-winner-removed growth and no liquidation

official_sequential_evaluation.purpose: The half-year periods are sequential research intervals, not indefinitely sealed final holdouts.

intervals.action: Open immediately after the pre-2024 strategy is frozen.

official_sequential_evaluation.decision_rule: After each interval, retire the information unit immediately if realistic after-cost performance is structurally far from the 1% daily geometric-growth objective. If promising, use only information available through that interval's cutoff to freeze the next version and evaluate it in the next half-year.
official_sequential_evaluation.oos_semantics: An interval already inspected may guide the next version but may never be claimed later as a fresh independent OOS test for that modified version.
